#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353LL;

ll mod_add(ll a, ll b) {
    ll v = a + b;
    return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
}

ll mod_mul(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a * b) % MOD;
}

ll mod_mul_many(initializer_list<ll> args) {
    ll r = 1;
    for (ll x : args) r = mod_mul(r, x);
    return r;
}

ll mod_pow(ll a, ll e) {
    ll r = 1;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1) r = mod_mul(r, a);
        a = mod_mul(a, a);
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return r;
}

ll mod_inv(ll x) {
    return mod_pow(x, MOD - 2);
}

vector<ll> fact, inv_fact;

ll ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return mod_mul_many({fact[n], inv_fact[r], inv_fact[n - r]});
}

ll small_inv(int n) {
    return mod_mul(inv_fact[n], fact[n - 1]);
}

ll parity_sign(ll k) {
    return (k & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
}

void precompute_fact(int max_n) {
    fact.resize(max_n + 1);
    inv_fact.resize(max_n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max_n; i++) {
        fact[i] = mod_mul(fact[i - 1], i);
    }
    inv_fact[max_n] = mod_inv(fact[max_n]);
    for (int i = max_n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        inv_fact[i] = mod_mul(inv_fact[i + 1], i + 1);
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    precompute_fact(n + m);

    ll phaseSize = 1;
    ll p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = mod_mul_many({p, n - i, small_inv(n + m - i)});
        phaseSize = mod_add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    ll answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        ll sign = parity_sign(k + 1);
        ll numPhases = mod_mul(m + k, small_inv(k));
        ll term = mod_mul_many({sign, ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize});
        answer = mod_add(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
